verses.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.2: I say to the children of Israel: Take for me a tithe from each man who gives his heart to me. You shall take my tithes.
verses.3: And this is the tribute that you shall take from them: gold, silver, and copper.
verses.4: And the vile and worthless things, and the rotten and worthless things, and also the six kinds of worthless things.
verses.5: And there are also sheep that live on the fields, and there are also goats that live in the bushes.
verses.6: Honey for the altar in heaven, honey for the sacrifices and for the sprinkling of holy water.
verses.7: The rocks of Shoham and the rocks of Miluim are suitable for making pottery and other items.
verses.8: And they made a place for me to dwell in their midst. I lived among them.
verses.9: Just as I see you now, I also see the structure of the house, and the structure of everything else within it. And so it shall be.
verses.10: And they made a structure out of wooden beams. Its length was one and a half meters, its width was also one and a half meters, and its height was also one and a half meters.
verses.11: And you saw that it was pure gold, both inside and outside the house. You also made a golden frame around it.
verses.12: And you shall make four gold decorations for it. You shall place them on its four corners. Two decorations shall be placed on one side of it, and two decorations shall be placed on the other side.
verses.13: And you made the doors out of cedar wood, and you gilded them with gold.
verses.14: And you shall carry the banners on the sides of the ark, so that you can carry the ark in the air.
verses.15: In the days of spring, they will be separate from us; they will not be separated from us.
verses.16: And you will give to the sky that which I have given you.
verses.17: And you made a golden crown, pure gold. Its length was one and a half cubits, and its width was also one and a half cubits.
verses.18: And you made two golden rings of great size. You made them from two ends of the necklace.
verses.19: And make one ridge from each side of this area. From both sides of the ridge, make ridges on its two ends.
verses.20: And the cherubim had wings spread out upward; their wings were covered with feathers. Their faces were facing one another, towards the throne. Thus were the faces of the cherubim.
verses.21: And you will place the crown on the head from above; and to the head, you will give the honor that I have given you.
verses.22: And I will go to you there, and I will speak to you from above the altar, between the two witnesses who stand on the ark of the covenant. I will tell you everything I command you to tell the children of Israel.
verses.23: And you made a table of acacia wood. Its length was very long, and its width was also very wide. Its height was about half a cubit.
verses.24: And you saw that it was pure gold; so you made a golden ring around it.
verses.25: And you made a frame for it, with a golden border around it.
verses.26: And you made for him four golden bracelets. You placed the bracelets on the four feet of his legs.
verses.27: For the sake of the covenant, the tablets will be set aside for use by women alone, so that they can carry the sacred objects.
verses.28: And you made the candlesticks of wood. You covered them with gold, and then you placed the lampstands on them.
verses.29: And you shall make his pots, his bowls, and his utensils, into which pure gold is poured.
verses.30: And you shall place the bread on the plate before me, always.
verses.31: And you shall make a pure gold lampstand. Its base, arms, and petals shall be of gold as well.
verses.32: And from her side, five horns emerged. Three of those horns were from her right side, and three more were from her left side.
verses.33: Three plants that produce flowers and fruits in one plant. And three more plants that also produce flowers and fruits in one plant. In this way, there are six plants that grow from the seed.
verses.34: And in the meadow, there are four fields of flowers, each with its own petals and blossoms.
verses.35: And cover both sides of the two openings with it. Cover both sides of the two openings with it, so that there are six openings that emerge from the furnace.
verses.36: Their ornaments and the items they buy from there will all be made of pure gold.
verses.37: And you made seven lamps from it, and you lit those lamps. Then you lit them over its sides.
verses.38: And its crowns and decorations are made of pure gold.
verses.39: A pure gold ring will be used to make all these utensils.
verses.40: And see and do what you see in their designs, which you see on that mountain.
